preconditions.description: Attacker must hold EthBurn tokens to trigger transfer functions
Contract must have accumulated tokens >= swapTokensAtAmount to trigger swapAndSendDividends
Attacker needs a malicious contract that can receive ETH and reenter during external calls

exploit_hint: Create a malicious contract with a receive() function that reenters the EthBurn contract during swapAndSendDividends() external calls. Attack flow: 1) Acquire EthBurn tokens, 2) Trigger transfers to accumulate fees in contract (balance >= swapTokensAtAmount), 3) Execute a sell transaction that triggers swapAndSendDividends(), 4) During the ETH distribution calls (to dividendTracker, marketingWallet, devWallet), reenter via transfer() to exploit the window before buyAmount/sellAmount are reset, 5) Potentially drain additional funds or receive duplicate dividend payments through the reentrancy.
